$comment: P0 budgets for docs/CONTRACT.md §11 (no resident process; the browser parses `log read`). Justification and measured data: docs/performance.md. Evaluated by scripts/performance-gate.mjs against a run of scripts/perf/run.sh. Memory is RssAnon because the OpenWrt kernels have no smaps/smaps_rollup. CPU is percent of one guest CPU. P6 package_floor_pp: the smallest noise allowance for on minus the hand-written drop-in. Recalibrate only with measured data recorded in docs/performance.md.

accelerators.$comment: Per-accelerator handling (docs/performance.md → Budgets). The top-level numbers apply unless the run's accelerator overrides them. hvf (armsr-armv8, Apple silicon) is the run of record. tcg is a smoke run: report_only metrics are computed and reported but do not decide the verdict. Other accelerators (kvm) use the top-level numbers.
